name: Session 1 - The forgotten Isles
summary: The filthy casuals session 1 - The forgotten Isles
body:
Session intro
The storm came with no warning.
One moment, the sky was clear, the sea a mirror of sunlight and calm. The next, black clouds rolled over the horizon like a warhost, swallowing the sky. Winds howled like banshees, tearing sails and snapping ropes, and monstrous waves rose from the deep, each one threatening to crack your ship in two.
You remember the panic, the shouts of the crew, the lightning that struck the mast. And then... the fall. Cold water. Darkness.
You wake to the screech of gulls and the lapping of waves against sand.
The taste of salt clings to your tongue. Your backpack is missing and the remainder of your gear is waterlogged but intact. Around you lie splintered boards—remnants of your vessel—and the unconscious or groaning forms of your companions. The sea stretches endlessly behind you, and ahead, a dense wall of jungle breathes with the humid pulse of life.
You're on an island—but not one you've ever seen charted. The beach is narrow, hemmed by steep cliffs on one side and thick, shadow-choked trees on the other. Strange footprints dot the wet sand—three-toed, clawed, and fresh. Somewhere in the trees, something lets out a guttural, warbling cry.
There is no sign of your crew. No ship. No way back.
But there is something watching from the treeline.
Welcome to the Isle of the Forgotten.
